title: Tarantula (TV series)
lead_cast: Carson MellDan BakkedahlJacob VargasLauren WeedmanSteve Jones

premise_summary: Tarantula is an American adult animated sitcom. It is adapted from a web series of the same name, which was released on YouTube by its creator, Carson Mell, from 2012 to 2015. It aired on TBS from December 4 until December 25, 2017.
